Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
Q: What is the Jaanch – Men’s Hairfall Screening Advanced?
Ans.
The Men’s Hairfall Screening Advanced is a doctor-recommended diagnostic package by Thyrocare that includes 47 essential parameters. It is designed to identify the underlying causes of hair loss in men by evaluating nutritional deficiencies, hormonal imbalances, thyroid dysfunction, and inflammation markers. This detailed analysis supports accurate diagnosis and effective treatment planning for hairfall issues.
Q: What tests are included in this profile?
Ans.
This package covers a wide range of parameters including thyroid profile (TSH, T3, T4), CBC, vitamin D and B12 levels, iron studies, ferritin, calcium, phosphorus, magnesium, and zinc. It also includes key hormonal and inflammatory markers like cortisol, dihydrotestosterone (DHT), sex hormone-binding globulin (SHBG), Anti-Nuclear Antibody (ANA), and C-Reactive Protein (CRP) to assess autoimmune or chronic inflammation-related causes of hair loss.
Q: Why is this test important for men experiencing hairfall?
Ans.
Hair loss in men can result from several causes, including nutritional deficiencies, stress, hormonal imbalances, or even autoimmune disorders. This test helps pinpoint the exact reason behind hairfall so that proper treatment—whether through supplements, medications, or lifestyle changes—can be started. Early diagnosis can prevent further hair loss and even reverse damage in many cases.
Q: Who should take this test?
Ans.
This test is ideal for men experiencing unexplained hair thinning, receding hairline, patchy hair loss, or a sudden increase in hair fall. It is especially recommended if there is a family history of baldness, or if lifestyle factors like stress, poor diet, or medical conditions may be contributing to the problem.
Q: Is fasting required before taking the test?
Ans.
Yes, fasting for 8–10 hours is recommended before sample collection for accurate assessment of blood sugar, hormone, and nutritional levels. Water is allowed during the fasting period.
Q: How is the sample collected?
Ans.
A certified technician from Thyrocare will visit your home to collect the blood sample. BookMyTest offers free home sample collection across India, making the process convenient and hassle-free.
Q: How soon will I get the results?
Ans.
Test results are generally available within 24 to 48 hours. Reports are delivered via email, WhatsApp, and are also accessible through your BookMyTest account dashboard.
Q: What is the cost of the Men’s Hairfall Screening Advanced test?
Ans.
This profile is available at a budget-friendly price, including free home sample collection. You can check the current price and book the test online at www.bookmytest.co.in.
